mapper.sql: C.repository_id = #{repositoryId} AND namespace = #{namespace} AND name = #{name} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: /* VIRTUAL_THREAD_OPTIMIZED EXISTENCE_CHECK */ SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ${format}_asset a JOIN ${format}_asset_blob ab ON ab.asset_blob_id = a.asset_blob_id WHERE (ab.blob_ref = #{blobRef} OR ab.blob_ref in (SELECT /*+ HASH_JOIN(a ab cr repository) */ blob_ref FROM ${format}_asset a JOIN ${format}_asset_blob ab ON ab.asset_blob_id = a.asset_blob_id JOIN ${format}_content_repository cr ON a.repository_id = cr.repository_id JOIN repository ON repository.id = cr.config_repository_id where a.path = #{path} AND repository.name = #{repository})) AND (a.component_id IS NULL OR a.component_id = (SELECT a.component_id FROM ${format}_component c WHERE a.component_id = c.component_id)) );
